_comment: Ricoh GR-style colour looks (docs/LIBRARY_V1.md, section "Ricoh-style pack"). Same schema and camera-feasible controls as library_v3.json. Own designs from Ricoh's published Image Control names and descriptions; Ricoh publishes no numbers, so no measured data is used. The character is carried by sat/hue/light and H/M/S tone so that it survives on bodies without WB shift or Blacks/Whites (E-M1 II); WB, Blacks/Whites, grain and vignette only add to it.

ricoh_positive.name: Pos. Film
ricoh_positive.description: Slide-film punch: rich but not Velvia-loud colour, deep teal-leaning skies, crimson reds, golden oranges, olive-leaning greens, firm contrast with dense shadows.
ricoh_positive.source: Own design after Ricoh's Positive Film Image Control (GR III / IIIx / IV): "vivid, high-contrast colours like positive film" in Ricoh's descriptions. No Ricoh data used.

ricoh_negative.name: Neg. Film
ricoh_negative.description: Soft, faded negative print: low contrast, lifted blacks, muted colour, teal-shifted greens and cyan-leaning skies, light warm skin.
ricoh_negative.source: Own design after Ricoh's Negative Film Image Control (GR III / IIIx firmware 1.50, GR IV): "subdued, low-contrast colour like negative film" in Ricoh's descriptions. No Ricoh data used.

ricoh_retro.name: Retro
ricoh_retro.description: Old print: warm and yellowed, faded blues and skies, olive-yellow greens, soft contrast with lifted blacks, darker corners.
ricoh_retro.source: Own design after Ricoh's Retro Image Control (GR series): a faded, warm-toned "old photo" look with toning and vignetting. The yellowed greys come from the WB shift, which bodies without WB shift (E-M1 II) cannot show. No Ricoh data used.

ricoh_cine_yellow.name: Cine Yellow
ricoh_cine_yellow.description: Warm cinema grade: golden-amber cast, yellow-olive foliage, muted teal skies, gentle contrast with soft highlights.
ricoh_cine_yellow.source: Own design after Ricoh's Cinema (Yellow) Image Control (GR IV, 2025): a yellow-leaning cinematic tone. Ricoh publishes only the name and a short description. No Ricoh data used.

ricoh_cine_green.name: Cine Green
ricoh_cine_green.description: Cool cinema grade: green-teal cast, teal skies, deep cyan-green foliage, muted warm colours, lifted blacks and low contrast.
ricoh_cine_green.source: Own design after Ricoh's Cinema (Green) Image Control (GR IV, 2025): a green-leaning cinematic tone. Ricoh publishes only the name and a short description. No Ricoh data used.
